t: Augustus turned the war-torn Roman Republic into a monarchy in 27 BCE while keeping the Senate and consuls as a republican facade.
Its professional legions, 80,000 km of roads and Roman law bound a realm stretching from Britain to Mesopotamia.
The West fell gradually through civil war, Gothic and Vandal invasions and lost revenues, ending when Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus in 476.
dyk: When Odoacer deposed the last Western emperor in 476, he simply sent the imperial regalia to Constantinople, and contemporaries barely remarked on it.
ev: Octavian defeats Mark Antony and Cleopatra VII at the Battle of Actium
The Senate grants Octavian the title Augustus, making him Rome's first emperor
Arminius destroys three legions under Varus in the Teutoburg Forest, fixing the Rhine frontier
The Edict of Caracalla extends citizenship to virtually all free inhabitants of the empire
Constantine and Licinius agree the Edict of Milan, ending the persecution of Christians
Gothic forces kill Emperor Valens and much of the Eastern field army at Adrianople
Alaric's Visigoths sack Rome, shattering the myth of Roman invulnerability
Odoacer deposes Romulus Augustulus, the last Western Roman emperor
